questions.stem: Two $6\ \Omega$ resistors are connected in parallel, and this combination is connected in series with a third $6\ \Omega$ resistor. The equivalent resistance is

options.whyWrong: This treats all three resistors as parallel.
This adds two in series first and then puts that in parallel with the third: the wrong grouping.
This treats all three resistors as series.

questions.solution:
**Key idea:** reduce the parallel pair first.

1. $6 \parallel 6 = \dfrac{6 \times 6}{12} = 3\ \Omega$
2. In series with $6\ \Omega$: **$R = 9\ \Omega$**
hints: Which two resistors share both end points?

questions.stem: A cell of EMF $12\ \text{V}$ and internal resistance $1\ \Omega$ is connected across an external resistor of $5\ \Omega$. Find the potential difference across the terminals of the cell, in volts.
hints: Find the current using the total resistance, including the internal resistance.
